title_zh: 維斯帕拉德 第 1 章
orig_source: avesta.org，蓋爾德納校本轉寫（舊式羅馬轉寫）
en_source: 《東方聖書》第 31 卷，1887；公有領域
licence: 原文轉寫與英譯均取自 avesta.org（Joseph H. Peterson 編）；英譯為《東方聖書》舊譯，已入公有領域。繁中為本站自譯。

segments.orig:
nivaêdhayemi hañkârayemi ratavô mainyavanãm
ratavô gaêthyanãm ratavô upâpanãm
ratavô upasmanãm ratavô frapterejâtãm
ratavô ravascarâtãm ratavô cangranghâcãm
ashaonãm ashahe rathwãm.

nivaêdhayemi hañkârayemi ýâiryaêibyô
ashahe ratubyô, maidhyôizaremayehe payanghô
ashaonô ashahe rathwô, nivaêdhayemi hañkârayemi
maidhyôishemahe vâstrô-dâtainyehe ashaonô
ashahe rathwô, nivaêdhayemi hañkârayemi
paitishhahyehe hahyehe ashaonô ashahe rathwô, nivaêdhayemi
hañkârayemi ayâthrimahe fraourvaêshtrimahe
varshniharshtaheca ashaonô ashahe rathwô, nivaêdhayemi
hañkârayemi maidhyâiryehe saredhahe ashaonô
ashahe rathwô, nivaêdhayemi hañkârayemi
hamaspathmaêdayehe aretô-karethnahe ashaonô
ashahe rathwô.
segments.en:
I announce, and I (will) complete (my Yasna) to the Yearly
festivals, the lords of the ritual order, to Maidyozarem, the
milk-giver, the holy lord of the ritual order, and to Maidyoshahem,
the pasture-giver, and to Paitishahem, the corn-giver, and to
Ayathrem, the furtherer or breeder, the spender of the seed of
males, and to Maidyarem the cold, the holy lord of the ritual
order, and to Hamaspathmaidyem, the especial time for ritual deeds,
holy lords of the ritual order.
segments.zh: 我宣告，並且我（將）完成（我的亞斯納）致週年節慶，儀式秩序的領主，致邁迪奧扎雷姆，奶酪給予者，儀式秩序的聖者領主，以及致邁迪奧舍姆，牧場給予者，以及致佩蒂沙赫姆，穀物給予者，以及致阿亞特雷姆，進一步者或育種者，男性種子的花費者，以及致邁迪亞雷姆，寒冷，儀式秩序的聖者領主，以及致哈姆斯帕特邁迪姆，儀式行為的特殊時間，儀式秩序的聖者領主。

segments.orig:
nivaêdhayemi hañkârayemi gaêthanãm
ånghairyehe ashaonô ashahe rathwô ýat
ånghairyô zîzanen, nivaêdhayemi hañkârayemi
staotanãm ýesnyanãm hañdâtanãm
hufrâyashtanãm ashaonô ashahe rathwô,
nivaêdhayemi hañkârayemi staotanãm ýesnyanãm
hañdâtanãm hufrâyashtanãm ashaonãm
ashaoninãmca ashahe myazdanãm.
segments.en:
I announce, and I (will) complete (my Yasna) to the settlements
of the future one, when the future shall produce them as it were
anew, and I celebrate and will complete (my Yasna) to the Praises
of the Yasna collected, completed, and much-offered, and to the
Myazdas of the saints of the ritual, male and female.
segments.zh: 我宣告，並且我（將）完成（我的亞斯納）致未來一個的定居點，當未來將以重新產生它們般產生它們，我慶祝並將完成（我的亞斯納）致亞斯納的讚美詩，被收集、完成、以及大量獻上，以及致聖者的米亞茲達，儀式的，男性和女性的。

segments.orig:
nivaêdhayemi hañkârayemi saredhaêibyô
ashahe ratubyô ahunahe vairyehe frasraothrahe ashaonô
ashahe rathwô, nivaêdhayemi hañkârayemi
ashahe vahishtahe staothwahe ashaonô ashahe rathwô,
nivaêdhayemi hañkârayemi ýenghê-
hâtayå hufrâyashtayå ashaonyå ashahe
rathwô.
segments.en:
And I announce, and will complete (my Yasna) to the Seasons,
the lords of the ritual order, and to the heard recital of the
Ahuna-vairya, and to Righteousness the Best, to him who has (?)
our praise, and to the Yenghe hatam , the frequent chant of sacrifice,
the holy, and ruling in the ritual order.
segments.zh: 我宣告，並且將完成（我的亞斯納）致季節，儀式秩序的領主，以及致阿胡納-瓦伊里亞的聽聞誦讀，以及致正義最佳，致他誰有 （？） 我們的讚美，以及致英格赫 哈塔姆 ，犧牲的頻繁誦讀，聖者，以及儀式秩序的統治。

segments.orig:
nivaêdhayemi hañkârayemi ahunavaityå
gâthayå ashaonyå ashahe rathwô,
nivaêdhayemi hañkârayemi khenãnãm
pouru-saredhô-vîrô-vãthwanãm
mazdadhâtanãm ashaonãm ashahe rathwãm,
nivaêdhayemi hañkârayemi ahumatô ratumatô
ashaonô ashahe rathwô, nivaêdhayemi hañkârayemi
ýasnahe haptanghâtôish ashaonô ashahe
rathwô, nivaêdhayemi hañkârayemi areduyå
âpô anâhitayå ashaonyå ashahe rathwô.
segments.en:
And I announce and complete (my Yasna) to the Gatha Ahunavaiti,
the holy, ruling in the ritual order, and to those women who bring
forth many sons of many talents, Mazda-given, and holy lords of
the ritual order, and to that (chant) which has its Ahu and its
Ratu (before it in the Yasna).
And I celebrate, and will complete (my sacrifice) to the Yasna Haptanghaiti , 
holy, and ruling in the ritual order, [and to the
water Ardvi Anahita].
segments.zh:
我宣告並完成（我的亞斯納）致阿胡納瓦伊提伽薩，聖者，儀式秩序的統治，以及致那些婦女，她們帶來許多多才多藝的兒子，馬茲達賜予的，以及儀式秩序的聖者領主，以及致那（誦讀）擁有其阿胡和其拉圖（在亞斯納之前）。
我慶祝，並將完成（我的祭祀）致亞斯納哈普塔nghaiti ，聖者，以及儀式秩序的統治，[以及致水阿爾德維 阿娜希塔]。

segments.orig:
nivaêdhayemi hañkârayemi ushtavaityå
gâthayå ashaonyå ashahe rathwô, nivaêdhayemi
hañkârayemi gairinãm ashahvâthranãm
pouru-hvâthranãm mazdadhâtanãm ashaonãm
ashahe rathwãm, nivaêdhayemi hañkârayemi
speñtâ-manyêush gâthayå ashaonyå
ashahe rathwô, nivaêdhayemi hañkârayemi
verethrakhnahe ahuradhâtahe vanaiñtyåsca uparatâtô
ashaonô ashahe rathwô.
segments.en:
And I announce, and I (will) complete (my Yasna) to the Gatha
Ushtavaiti, the holy, ruling in the ritual order, and to the mountains
which shine with holiness, the abundantly brilliant and Mazda-made,
the holy lords of the ritual order.
And I announce, and (will) complete (my Yasna) to the Gatha Spenta-mainyu,
the holy, ruling in the ritual order; and I celebrate and will
complete (my Yasna) to Verethraghna (the blow of victory) Ahura-given,
the holy lord of the ritual order.
segments.zh:
我宣告，並且我（將）完成（我的亞斯納）致烏什塔瓦提伽薩，聖者，儀式秩序的統治，以及致那些山脈，它們發光與聖潔，極其閃亮且馬茲達製造，儀式秩序的聖者領主。
我宣告，並且（將）完成（我的亞斯納）致斯彭塔-曼紐優伽薩，
聖者，儀式秩序的統治；我慶祝並將
完成（我的亞斯納）致維雷特拉格納（勝利之擊）阿胡拉賜予的，
儀式秩序的聖者領主。

segments.orig:
nivaêdhayemi hañkârayemi vohuxshathrayå
gâthayå ashaonyå ashahe rathwô, nivaêdhayemi
hañkârayemi mithrahe vouru-gaoyaotôish râmanasca
hvâstrahe ashaonô ashahe rathwô, nivaêdhayemi
hañkârayemi vahishtôishtôish gâthayå
ashaonyå ashahe rathwô, nivaêdhayemi hañkârayemi
dahmayå vanghuyå âfritôish dahmaheca narsh
ashaonô ukhraheca taxmahe dâmôish upamanahe
ýazatahe ashaonô ashahe rathwô.
segments.en:
And I announce, and (will) complete (my Yasna) to the Gatha
Vohu-khshathra, holy, ruling in the ritual order, and to Mithra
of the wide pastures, and to Raman Hvastra, the holy lords of
the ritual order. And I celebrate and will complete my Yasna to
the Gatha Vahishtoishti, the holy, ruling in the ritual order.
And I celebrate and will complete my Yasna to the good and pious
Prayer for blessings, the benediction of the pious, and to that
Yazad, the redoubted and swift Curse of the wise, the holy lord
of the ritual order.
segments.zh:
我宣告，且（將）完成（我的亞斯納），獻給伽薩
沃胡‧赫沙特拉，聖潔的，在儀軌秩序中掌管者，以及獻給密特拉
廣闊草原的，以及獻給拉曼‧赫瓦斯特拉，儀軌秩序的
聖主們。我頌讚且將完成我的亞斯納，獻給
瓦希什圖伊什特‧伽薩，聖潔的，在儀軌秩序中掌管者。
我頌讚且將完成我的亞斯納，獻給善良而虔敬的
祈求福祉，虔誠者的祝福，以及對那
亞茲德，智者的可怕而迅速的詛咒，聖者之主
儀式秩序的

segments.orig:
nivaêdhayemi hañkârayemi airyamanô
ishyehe ashaonô ashahe rathwô, nivaêdhayemi
hañkârayemi fshûshô-mãthrahe
ashaonô ashahe rathwô, nivaêdhayemi hañkârayemi
ratêush berezô hadhaoxtahe ashaonô ashahe rathwô.
segments.en:
And I announce, and (will) complete (my Yasna) to the Airyema-ishyo,
the holy lord of the ritual order, and to the Fshusho-mathra ,
and to that lofty lord Hadhaokhdha , the holy lord of the ritual
order.
segments.zh: 我宣佈並（將）完成（我的亞斯納），獻給艾里耶馬—伊什尤，儀軌秩序的聖潔主宰；獻給夫舒紹—曼特拉；獻給那位崇高的主宰哈達奧赫達，儀軌秩序的聖潔主宰。

segments.orig:
nivaêdhayemi hañkârayemi âhurôish
frashnahe âhurôish tkaêshahe âhurôish
dâh'yumahe âhurôish zarathushtrôtemahe
ashaonô ashahe rathwô, nivaêdhayemi hañkârayemi
hadishaheca vâstravatô vâstrô-beretaheca
gave hudhånghe gaoidyeheca narsh ashaonô!!
segments.en:
And I announce, and (will) complete (my Yasna) to the questions
asked of Ahura, and to the lore of Ahura, to the Ahurian Dahvyuma 
( Dahyuma ), and to the Ahurian Zarathushtrotema, holy lords of
the ritual order, and to the farm-house with its pastures 
which give pasture to the Kine of blessed gift, and to the holy cattle-breeding
man.
segments.zh: 我宣佈並（將）完成（我的亞斯納），獻給向阿胡拉提出的問題，獻給阿胡拉的教義，獻給屬阿胡拉的達赫尤馬（Dahyuma），以及獻給屬阿胡拉的查拉圖什特羅特馬，儀軌秩序的聖潔主宰們；獻給帶著牧場的農舍——其為蒙福賜予的牲牛提供牧草，並獻給持阿沙的育牛之人。
